references.applied: A single expressive daylight arc, marked endpoints and a visible local time context; values come from the wall's solar model.
Pair the visual day story with readable sunrise and sunset values; show polar exceptions honestly.
Location permission is requested only from a tapped action; denied permission, timeout, retry and a Settings route are explicit. One-shot kilometre accuracy.
The decorative curve is accompanied by accessible textual values and the chart is clearly labelled a sunlight plan.
Keep duration and the one primary start action legible; separate the sleep plan from active countdown state.
Short familiar duration choices with one contextual cancel control once the timer is running.
The wall's known total and remaining time drive a determinate fade marker; disconnect freezes extrapolation and labels the last state.
Make daily schedule and the effect of enabling it explicit, with time and duration in the canonical page.
Use a strong readable schedule summary and an in-place native time control, with start and full-light endpoints.
Native time wheel stays in context; timezone is explicitly the wall's instead of silently using the phone's.
Separate schedule enabled state from saved time and transition duration; describe what the schedule changes.
